name: update-template
description:
Update template metadata by ID, alias, or Resend dashboard URL (name, subject, from, html, variables, etc.). After updating a published template, use publish-template again to make the changes live. To edit TipTap content, use compose-template instead.

**Note on html/text fields:** Setting html or text via this tool replaces any content previously set via compose-template. This switch is lossy — some content or formatting may be lost. Prefer compose-template for content changes. If the template was composed with TipTap content, ask the user before overwriting it with raw HTML.

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

html.description:
New HTML content for the template. Email HTML guidelines for client compatibility. Resend does not enforce them. Follow them when you write or restructure HTML yourself. When the user supplies HTML or asks for a targeted edit to existing HTML, keep their markup and styles as they are, including anything these guidelines advise against (for example background-image gradients), and change only what they asked for. STRUCTURE - Always include , , , - Layout must be table-based: , ,

for layout - Outer wrapper table at width="100%", inner content table at max 600px wide - Every table must have cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" CSS - All styles must be inline (style="..."): no

id.description: The template ID, alias, or Resend dashboard URL (e.g. https://resend.com/templates/<id>)

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

text.description: New plain text version of the message. If omitted while html changes, it is regenerated from the new html. Pass an empty string to keep it empty.

variables.description: New array of template variables (replaces existing variables).

fallbackValue.description: Default value used if the variable is not provided when sending.

key.description: The variable key. Recommend capitalizing (e.g., PRODUCT_NAME). NEVER include reserved names in this list: FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, EMAIL, RESEND_UNSUBSCRIBE_URL — they are automatically available and will cause a validation error if added.
